==English==

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{lb|en|publishing}} A [[softcover]] [[edition]] of a [[previously]] [[hardcover]] [[book]], usually [[produced]] with the [[exact]] same [[text]] as the [[hardcover]].
# {{lb|en|publishing}} A [[paperback]] [[book]] that is in one of the [[standard]] [[size]]s for small [[paperback]]s, generally for [[genre fiction]].
# {{lb|en|comics}} A type of [[comic book]] primarily containing [[previously]] [[published]] [[material]], traditionally in a [[periodical]] [[format]], and [[bound]] together as one work, or part of a series itself.
